documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Uniparts India reported a 27% year-on-year revenue growth in Q1 FY27, driven by strong performance in the construction equipment segment which now accounts for 45% of total revenue. Management expects FY27 growth to exceed FY26 levels, supported by a robust new business order book of over INR 225 crores. The company is expanding its global footprint with Mexico warehouse operations starting in Q3 FY27 and is actively evaluating half a dozen acquisition opportunities in hydraulics and fabrication. Uniparts India reported its Q1 FY27 financial results with 27% year-on-year revenue growth, 55% EBITDA growth, and 64% PAT growth. Management highlighted that the restoration of the Ludhiana facility's finishing shop is progressing on schedule with uninterrupted customer supplies, and Mexico operations remain on track for first warehouse deliveries in Q3.

guidance.claim: The company expects FY27 revenue growth to be higher than the growth achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates Q2 FY27 performance to be in line with the first quarter.
guidance.quote: Q2 looks very robust, and I think Q2 should be in line with Q1.

guidance.claim: Mexico operations are expected to generate mid-single-digit million dollar revenue in FY27.
guidance.quote: For FY27, we believe that this revenue should be in mid-single-digit million dollar level.

guidance.claim: The company expects to maintain EBITDA margins above 20% for FY27.
guidance.quote: We are going to deliver FY27 also very comfortably over the 20% plus margin, right?

guidance.claim: The fabrication vertical is projected to become a significant part of the business within the next two years.
guidance.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue growth in FY27 to match the growth rate achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: The company expects Q1 FY27 performance to be consistent with the results of Q4 FY26.
guidance.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure spending in the U.S. and Europe is driving healthy order visibility in the construction segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the U.S. and the government-led investments in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: The large agricultural equipment market is expected to hit a cyclical bottom in 2026 with recovery starting in 2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agriculture equipment volumes are beginning to show signs of recovery after three years of decline.
demand_outlook.quote: After 3 consecutive years of volume decline, we are beginning to see some recovery in unit volumes and the direction of growth is encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects the aftermarket segment to return to growth as tariffs normalize.
demand_outlook.quote: With tariffs having since come down, we expect this to normalize and the segment to return to growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure-led spending in the US and Europe is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility in the construction equipment segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the US and government led spending in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Aftermarket revenue was flat year-on-year and represents approximately 12% of revenues in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Aftermarket represents approximately 12% of revenues in Q1 FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agriculture conditions remain subdued, with leading OEMs indicating CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom and recovery expected through CY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Conditions remain subdued, as has been widely acknowledged across the industry. Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Management believes the global agriculture and construction equipment cycles are beginning to recover.
demand_outlook.quote: The final quarter of FY26 provided further evidence that the global agriculture and construction equipment cycle is turning.

demand_outlook.claim: The North American construction equipment market is expected to grow in FY27, particularly in the second half.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture market in North America is projected to grow by approximately 5% in FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: The European construction equipment market shows signs of recovery, particularly in compact equipment.
demand_outlook.quote: In fact, the demand for compact equipment has been a bright spot and infrastructure-led spending supported by fiscal stimulus defense investment and energy transition projects is expected to provide a more stable demand environment throughout the year.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agricultural machinery OEMs indicate that the fourth quarter of FY26 was the cyclical low point.
demand_outlook.quote: Let me talk about the large agricultural machinery, continues to work through the current down cycle with leading OEMs affirming that quarter 4 of '26 represents a cyclical trough.

capex_expansion.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are scheduled for the third quarter of the current year.
capex_expansion.quote: Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company spent INR 12 crores on capital expenditure during the first quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: Annual organic capital expenditure is typically between 2.5% and 3.5% of total revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: our capex requirements as a business are roughly about 2.5% to 3.5% of our total revenue.

capex_expansion.claim: The restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule, and I am pleased to report that customer supply has remained uninterrupted throughout.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to maintain capital expenditure between 2.5% and 3.5% of its revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

capex_expansion.claim: Rebuilding of the fire-damaged Ludhiana facility is currently in progress.
capex_expansion.quote: And in parallel, the rebuilding effort is well underway.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter grew by 55% year-on-year to reach INR 90 crores.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR90 crores, registering strong 55% growth year-on-year and 10% growth sequentially, reflecting healthy operating leverage and disciplined cost management across the business.

margins_costs.claim: The company targets a material cost range between 34% and 37% of revenue.
margins_costs.quote: our material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%, and that's typical of our business.

margins_costs.claim: The company recorded a small inventory gain of approximately INR 1 crore in the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: There has been a small inventory gain that you will see on the face of the financials, and that's roughly about INR1 crore.

margins_costs.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin was 66.6% in Q1 FY27 compared to 65.6% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Profit Margin (As % of Revenue from Ops) 66.6% 64.7% 65.6%

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved an EBITDA margin of 24% in the fourth quarter and 22% for the full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Management considers a 20% EBITDA margin to be sustainable throughout the business cycle.
margins_costs.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle. And as volumes build through FY27, we expect to operate comfortably above that level.

margins_costs.claim: The introduction of a new wage code in November 2025 impacted profitability by INR 3.4 crores.
margins_costs.quote: This performance actually accounts for INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.

margins_costs.claim: Freight and raw material cost increases are passed through directly to customers.
margins_costs.quote: And I think as far as we are concerned, the freight and the raw material component of the cost is a direct pass-through to customers, right?

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing 12-month new business order book exceeds INR 225 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: The company currently holds a single-digit market share in the large tractor linkage segment.
orders_capacity.quote: In the above 70 HP three-point linkage, where like we've just discussed on the call, we are at a single-digit market share.

orders_capacity.claim: Net working capital was 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of June 30.
orders_capacity.quote: Net working capital stands at 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of 30th June, reflecting our near-shoring and warehousing-led business model while remaining broadly under control.

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore, with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's revenue is now evenly split between the 3-point linkage and precision machine parts segments.
orders_capacity.quote: And that's why you see that today, your revenue from 3PL and PMP is almost 50-50 split.

orders_capacity.claim: Order books showed sequential improvement in the final quarter of FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Order books strengthened sequentially compared to the quarter 3 FY26, although the pace of recovery varied across geographies and industry segments.

capital_allocation.claim: The company ended the quarter with a net cash position of approximately INR 190 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Management is currently evaluating approximately six potential acquisition targets.
capital_allocation.quote: I think today, we have about half a dozen opportunities that we are closely looking at.

capital_allocation.claim: The company rebuilt its cash reserves to INR 190 crores within ten months of paying a special dividend.
capital_allocation.quote: Just to put this in context, when we declared the special dividend of INR101 crores in October of '25, our cash balance was approximately INR210 crores. Therefore, in just 10 months through focused operations and business growth, we have rebuilt to that level.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared a special dividend of INR 101 crore in October 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: To put this in context: when we declared the special dividend of INR 101cr in October 2025, our cash balance was approximately INR 210 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is net debt-free with a net cash position of INR 160 crores as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts distributed a total of INR 170 crores in dividends during FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital improved to 136 days as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net working capital is 136 days on our trailing 12-month revenue as of March 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: The West Asia situation is causing pressure on supply chains and input costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: The large agricultural equipment industry is expected to decline by mid-teens this year.
risks_headwinds.quote: We expect mid-teens decline in the large ag industry this year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility has caused customers to moderate purchases in the aftermarket segment.
risks_headwinds.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing in the aftermarket segment as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate purchasing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fire incident occurred at the finishing shop of the Ludhiana facility during the third quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: Escalations in West Asia during March created supply chain uncertainty and increased input prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action. Our teams responded with agility, putting alternate arrangements in place rapidly to ensure uninterrupted customer supplies. While the evolving geopolitical situation has resulted in increasing input prices
